candidates.change_summary: Replace the >= check so Deposit only accepts strictly greater than MinDeposit (msg.value > MinDeposit) altering which deposits update balances.
Remove the require overflow check line so Deposit updates balances without the require( ... ) guard.
Change balances update to overwrite instead of add (balances[msg.sender] = msg.value), so deposits set balance to the single deposit amount.
Move the TransferLog.AddMessage before the balances update, so reentrancy could observe log before balance changes (and balances may differ after Deposit in presence of reentrancy).
Insert an early return when msg.value equals MinDeposit, preventing the standard deposit path and leaving balances unchanged for that exact amount.
Delete the TransferLog.AddMessage call so deposits no longer write to the external Log (can affect reentrancy interactions changing balances observed).
